certified_services.serviceDescription:
Rev enables organizations to securely and efficiently deliver high
quality live and on-demand video to huge audiences internally,
using the organizations wide area network, and externally via the
cloud. Features of Rev include, the central management of video
assets, user access and permissions, network delivery devices,
and video publishing and distribution - in the most bandwidth-
efficient way possible.
